item.description: The Antigua and Barbuda-flagged bulk carrier CAPE DAO is reportedly sinking in the Gulf of Oman after being struck by a projectile. Maritime authorities issued a navigational warning identifying its position. Crew status is unknown. - NAVAREA IX

item.description: Saudi coalition forces say they intercepted another Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh today. Air raid alerts were heard earlier there and in Al-Kharj, which hosts Prince Sultan Air Base. No reports of damage or casualties.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork
